sentences.en: He is inclined to make light of his father's advice.
sentences.zh: 他倾向于轻视父亲的忠告。

sentences.en: Old people are inclined to look back on the past.
The Romans were civilized, but were also inclined to debauchery.
sentences.zh: 罗马人是文明的，但也倾向于放纵。

senses.zh: 有……意向，倾向于……；对……有兴趣的，有天赋的；倾斜的，有坡度的
点头；（使）倾向于；（使）倾斜（incline 的过去式和过去分词形式）
